items.question: What is the Global Toothgems 3D Studio?
items.answer: An online creative space for composing tooth jewellery: you place pieces on a 3D dentition, move them around, change shapes and colours, and see the composition from every angle. The library holds the shop's own gems, in their colours and sizes.

items.question: How does the two-day trial work?
items.answer: Create your account, then start the trial when you are ready: for 48 hours the Studio is yours with everything in the Essential plan, no card needed. The trial can be started once per account.

items.question: What happens after the trial ends?
items.answer: The editor closes and shows you the plans. Your creations and Gem Groups stay in your account: you find them again as soon as you subscribe.

items.question: Which subscription should I choose?
items.answer: Essential to imagine your first looks: 15 creations and 3 Gem Groups, the whole library and posts with the Global Toothgems watermark. Artist to work with your clients: 150 creations, 30 Gem Groups, the Global Toothgems templates, folders to file your creations and posts signed with your logo. Atelier to go further: unlimited creations and Gem Groups, your public Glowbook, the AI try-on, which lets your clients see your creations on their own smile, and layouts for your posts.

items.question: Can I change my subscription later?
items.answer: Yes, at any time from My subscription: a plan change is prorated on your next invoice. If you move to a smaller plan you keep all your creations — you save new ones once under the limit — and your Glowbook is hidden until you are back on Atelier. You can cancel for the end of the paid period, and withdraw within 14 days of your first payment.

items.question: Do I need experience with 3D design to get started?
items.answer: No. You pick a piece, place it on a tooth and move it with the mouse, a finger or the keyboard; the view turns with a drag. A help page comes with the editor.
